Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Bad Encounter
Cardtype: Reaction
Clan: Gangrel antitribu
Only usable when an acting minion enters combat with another minion. Usable by a tapped vampire of capacity 8 or more. Tap this reacting vampire. The acting vampire enters combat with this vampire instead.
I was in the wrong place at the wrong time
-- Depeche Mode, "Wrong"

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Miasmat
Messages.Body:
Seems like this'll make Enkidu kill everyone, always, even during a block happening across the table. Sounds really, really scary to me.

It is pretty interesting that it can be used to get a buddy out of a horrible unfriendly combat too. "Look, I know you just got blocked by that guy with a Flamethrower, but how about I play this Bad Encounter and we'll play nice in this combat, k?"

I think the special text for 8+ caps should cost a blood or something, or get removed.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
In any case, it's very !Gangrel

Vampires like Hukros that can't multi act well could also be interested, by being kind of multiacting (the small 1-cap or 2-cap rush or block, Hukros break skull).

Limiting to one per table turn (like On the qui vive) may be necessary, depending on tests.
